title: randia stricta
intro: Randia stricta, commonly known as the "Tamil Nadu Forest," is a species of flowering plant in the Rubiaceae family. It is a type of medicinal plant that has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Randia stricta include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Randia stricta include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as its antiseptic, antibacterial, and anti-diabetic properties.
